body: What it is? Aluminium is a highly conductive metal, meaning it easily transfers heat and cold. A "thermal break" is a non-metallic, low-conductivity material (often a reinforced polyamide strip) inserted between the inner and outer aluminum frames of the window.
How it works? This barrier "breaks" the thermal bridge, preventing heat from escaping in the winter and entering in the summer. This significantly improves the window's energy efficiency.
